origin: An original Everyday Cool room written for the collection in November 2026: the other science rooms applied outdoors, all at once. Fire lays, ferro rod, flint & steel and bow drill (with its difficulty stated plainly); a layered water filter whose honesty callout — filtering does not make water safe; boiling does (1 minute rolling, 3 at altitude, per the CDC) — is set in the page's biggest type; soap from rendered fat and wood-ash lye with saponification in plain words; pantry batteries and the series lesson; direction clues graded out loud (North Star A, shadow stick B, moss D); a four-card remedies shelf written as traditional use / evidence / limits (banana slug slime, willow bark with the full aspirin cautions, broadleaf plantain, oak bark); and a first-aid anchor section checked against the American Red Cross and Scouting America, with CPR deliberately presented as a learn-it-in-a-class skill. The room's design rule — a safety line and an honesty line on every card — is stated in its Help docs. Outgoing cross-links to Everyday Chemistry, Everyday Electronics, Tonight's Sky and Everyday Body; reciprocal cards recorded as a later add in COLLECTION.md. The banner is AI-generated artwork: a plush-style robot in Scout gear (campaign hat, orange neckerchief) by a stone-ring campfire, backpack and walking stick beside it, pine forest, dusk sky with the Big Dipper drawn in stars, and no lettering anywhere. All six outbound authority links were opened and read live on 2026-11-19; none were dropped.
